purpose: The jobs a decoder does for QNC besides playback, as a plug-in program beside the application (user 2026-10-23: blocks like a DLL, so that a change in one block cannot break another). Playback reaches a decoder program through qnc_packets_v1 (docs/70). A decoder registration of catalogs/decoders/catalog.json names its jobs program with "jobs": { "program": "<name>" }; then every job below goes to that program and none is done by another decoder.
transport: The JSON lines of qnc.module.plugin-process: the application's hello, the plug-in's ready, then one request at a time. A job may answer in parts (lines with "part") before its answer. A request { "id": 0, "op": "cancel", "body": <id> } stops the running job; a plug-in that does not end it in 2 s is stopped.

frames.body: { decoder, media, seconds: [f64], frame_rate: [num, den], mode: random | keyframe | exact, thumb: [w, h], out_dir }
frames.ok: null; the pictures are 000.jpg, 001.jpg... in out_dir

run.body: { decoder, media, start_sec, count, thumb, out_dir }
run.ok: null; count consecutive pictures from the exact picture at start_sec in out_dir

key_pictures.ok: [f64]: the presentation times (s) of the key pictures

audio_streams.part: { samples: base64 of interleaved f32 little-endian }

rules: media is the local file of a stored medium the plug-in only reads; out_dir is an empty temporary folder of the application, the only place it writes; decoder is the executable the catalog registers (host configuration). What is asked for comes from the stored record: the plug-in probes nothing and decides nothing about the media. Numbers are exact (no lost bits). An error is an answer, never a different result.
acceptance: tools/qnc-decoder-acceptance: every job against the built-in decoder on a medium that is only read (pictures byte for byte, key pictures, sound bit for bit), a cancelled job ends in time, another contract is refused.
